page.notes: Transcribed from a clear scan; no illegible words. Page number and running head are as printed. Long s normalised to plain s throughout. The printed hyphens at line ends (et-, partibus-, prædi-, Ce-, mini-, mol-) are kept. The page ends mid-word at "mol-", so the text continues on the next page. The headings "Dictum de Epate." and "Nunc de Musculis." are set in a larger, decorated type, so they are marked as level 2. Italic in "Ros" and "Musculus" is judged from the type and could be roman.
